name: waypoint
description: Rename and move Drive or local files while preserving identity and checking references.

interface.shortDescription: File and folder management with identity checks
interface.longDescription: Plan, execute, and verify authorized renames and moves using the existing Drive objects or local filesystem. Includes access-impact checks, collision handling, reference inspection, and rollback mapping. Requires the host to supply authorized tools.
defaultPrompt: Use Waypoint to audit or organize these files and folders without recreating Drive objects.
